# Dear Darling (G4)

[![Dear Darling (the green unicorn, right) beside Swoon Song in *Hard to Say Anything*](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/8/20/1435436/medium.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/1435436)

*Show still: **My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic**, Hasbro Studios / DHX Media.*

Dear Darling is the mint-green unicorn with a pale-blonde mane, blue eyes, and green hair bows among the three lovestruck admirers of Feather Bangs in *Hard to Say Anything* (S7E8). Her cutie mark depicts a carrot, tomato, and peas. The other two mares are the earth pony **Swoon Song** and pegasus **Fond Feather**; fans also call the trio the “Bimbettes” or “Gaston Girls.” See the [character color reference](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/262-Dear-Darling).

**Naming:** “Dear Darling” is a **fandom-assigned name**, not spoken in the episode. The [fan community’s naming account](https://www.fimfiction.net/group/212388/bimbette-ponies) identifies her as the unicorn; the *Gameloft* mobile game instead calls her **Swoony Fanfilly**, describing a fan who fainted while trying to speak to Feather Bangs, as recorded in the [unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies). These labels refer to the same on-screen design, not a secret identity.

**Speaking:** She participates in the trio’s swoons but has **no individually identified spoken line or confirmed voice-actor credit**. The [episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Hard_to_Say_Anything) attributes solo dialogue to the other two admirers. Her verified television appearance is S7E8; no further on-screen appearance is established here.

[![Dear Darling fan illustration; original vector credited to StarryshineViolet, edited version](https://derpicdn.net/img/download/2023/6/28/3153091.jpg)](https://www.derpibooru.org/images/3153091)

*Fan art: vector attributed to **StarryshineViolet**; the linked post documents an edited version.*

## Important moments

Both scenes are in the verified [official full episode, *Hard to Say Anything* (S7E8)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GSMf71auL2M). **Scene timestamps unavailable**; no unverified timestamp is supplied.

1. **Swooning over Feather Bangs — S7E8, “Hard to Say Anything.”** Dear Darling and the other admirers visibly melt over Feather’s juggling and romantic showmanship, establishing his popularity even while Sugar Belle remains unconvinced.
2. **A chance to meet their crush — S7E8, “Hard to Say Anything.”** After Sugar Belle chooses Big McIntosh, the Cutie Mark Crusaders point Feather toward the three admirers; his admission that ordinary conversation frightens him gives their running gag a more sympathetic ending.
